lineage.description: Road network data was extracted from the OpenStreetMap database using HOT's export pipeline, filtering all features with a non-null 'highway' tag within Canada's national boundary. The resulting line geometries and associated attributes (name, highway class, surface, lanes, etc.) were exported in multiple GIS formats (Shapefile, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage) for use in disaster risk and humanitarian applications.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.description: Volunteered geographic information from OpenStreetMap providing road network geometries and attributes (highway type, surface, lanes, etc.) for Canada. Data is extracted and exported by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) for use in GIS applications.
